Independent rate. Self-funded bands and independent brands can ask for a reduced fee.
Payment & terms

Half at kickoff, half before handoff. We agree a cap in advance for extra work at 1,200 NOK per hour. We confirm licences, outside costs and the rights to the finished work with you in writing.

Who you’ll
work with.

We’re a creative team in Trondheim with more than a decade of experience across industry, research and the arts. Show us a field notebook, a rough cut or a voice memo from rehearsal. That’s the material we build on together.

How we work.

Soundings is an imagined coastal research project. Follow a photograph from the first call all the way to a logo on a conference poster.

  1. Step 00

    Handshake

    Email us a few lines about your project. On a short call we find out what’s worth exploring together. For Soundings, the conversation starts with a photograph from the coast.

  2. Step 0145 min

    Set the direction

    Bring your research, ideas and any EU or NFR funding guidelines. We agree who the logo needs to reach and where it will appear. Here, a break in the ridgeline gives us a shape to work with.

  3. Step 0245 min

    See the thinking

    We bring two hand-drawn directions and explain what led to each. A follows the ridge and its reflection. B starts with an echo. We choose A together.

  4. Step 0345 min

    Build it together

    We try the chosen mark on a conference poster and in the corner of a slide. Seeing it at both sizes makes the last adjustments easier to agree before you sign off.

  5. Step 04

    Make it yours

    We email the editable artwork, SVG, PDF and PNG files, and a short guide to colours and fonts. Your team has what it needs to make the next poster or presentation.

See the logo package ↗

Compliance & control

Before we start, we agree who can see the drafts, who signs off and which institutional or funder rules apply. We put the usage rights in writing so you know where you can publish the work and what you can change yourself.
